Must try in Saigon!!
Apr 2026 • Couples
If you think you’ve had great bánh mì before, Banh Mi Ba Huynh will likely reset your benchmark.

Located just outside the core of District 1 near a busy traffic circle, it’s a quick and inexpensive Grab ride from most central hotels. The setup is a mix of indoor and outdoor space, and while there’s almost always a line, it moves with impressive efficiency. The steady stream of delivery drivers alongside dine-in and takeaway customers tells you everything you need to know about local demand.

We visited twice in four days—rare for us, but completely justified. On the first visit, we ordered the large shareable bánh mì (85,000 VND / ~$3.25). “Shareable” is underselling it—this is essentially an American-sized portion. It comes boxed, with gloves, a knife, and vegetables on the side to preserve the baguette’s crunchiness. The result: a perfectly constructed sandwich with rich pâté, balanced fillings, and an exceptionally crisp, airy baguette. Texturally and flavor-wise, it’s as good as it gets.

It was compelling enough that we returned and each ordered the individual size (65,000 VND / ~$2.25), which is still more than sufficient for one person.

The interior seating area is air-conditioned with ceiling fans—functional and comfortable, if not elaborate. There’s also a drink bar offering Vietnamese coffee and juices, making it easy to round out a quick meal.

Bottom line: this is a must-visit in Ho Chi Minh City. Eat it fresh, ideally dine-in, and set your expectations high—this place delivers.

A great breakfast
Nov 2025 • Couples
The Shop got our attention after seeing an incredibly long queue that went on for ages. Every morning. It just had to be great, we thought.

Luckily for us, the long queue in the morning is pretty much all delivery drivers so we were able to order right next to them immediately.

You have a choice between a banh mi or s special banh mi. Lets be honest, who would even consider not going special. We chose the small version and took a seat inside. The food arrived before we could sit down. Incredibly fast. You get many side ingredients like pickles, Chili, cilantro & chives.

Although supposedly small we barely finished it. The sandwhich was packed to the brim. Whatever you expect in a banh mi volume wise, double it. So flavourfull and filling. A great place to start your day.

I think I just found the best BANH MI in Saigon!!!!
Jul 2025 • Solo
After trying a few places for some good Banh Mi, I was recommended to Madam Win by concierge at the Pullman Saigon. This is the best and easily to most tasty Banh Mi I have had from anywhere in Vietnam. There is a famous place in Hoi An for Banh but it has nothing on this place. The bread is exceptional, they use the traditional paste and its full of meat and fresh fillings. They pack the vegetables separately in a sealed plastic bag for you to add as you want and it comes in a well wrapped box with gloves. If you are seeking authentic fresh Banh Mi then go to Madam Win!!!

⭐ The very best Bánh Mì in Vietnam! ⭐
Feb 2025 • Couples
OMG!!! If you are looking for a really tasty Bánh Mì, then you should go here 100%! The buns are second to none – crispy on the outside, perfectly filled on the inside. The Bánh Mì Special is definitely a must-try, and without a doubt the best I have eaten during our trip through Vietnam (and there were a lot of them! 😉).

The Cà Phê Muối (salted coffee) is also phenomenal here – a delicious, creamy surprise that you really have to taste. There is often a queue, but if you walk in on the right, you will usually find a seat where you can enjoy yourself quietly.

This is one of those places you can’t skip. Highly recommended! 💯
